briefs.claim_en: Drinking hot water mixed with lemon juice kills the coronavirus.
briefs.brief_en: The World Health Organization (WHO) states there is no scientific evidence that home remedies such as lemon or drinking water prevent, flush out, or cure COVID-19. Multiple medical evaluations, including an advisory published by the National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine on 2020-04-22, explain that acidic drinks like lemon juice do not eliminate SARS-CoV-2 in human cells. Additional reporting and expert reviews by FactCheck.org (2020-04-02), AFP Fact Check (2020-03-12), BOOM Fact Check (2020-03-13), Snopes (2020-03-26), and PolitiFact confirm that infectious disease specialists found no clinical data showing hot beverages or lemon juice kill coronavirus inside the human body. Subsequent coverage by Alt News (2020-03-18) and NDTV Food (2021-05-05) reiterated the lack of therapeutic support.
gaps_en: Original source or specific post asserting the claim was not provided.
